items.title: Albert "Baby Brousse" Broussard Interview, 1961-02-20
items.q: And I played the piano behind him.

ctx.x: He could play the blues. Frank could play the blues.

That's the trumpet player. He's the guy that was known for playing Kellis Love. That's the way I would tell him. He was one of the main elements at Jacob Melendez's party. Now, Chris Kelly was the guy. He could sit right here with that little short brass trumpet he had. Cornet. Cornet, yeah. That's what it... It wasn't... Looked like it was just about 12 inches long. And that guy would sit down as I blow this imitation. That's the way I got an idea of blowing this imitation of the trumpet. I tried to sound my…
remember uh uh Willie Webber used to live on Mero Street, the trumpet player? He used to be a Slater?
